runtimeResult.message: Headless execution requires clarification before a repository plan can be created.

promptUnderstanding.reply: The requested rebuild conflicts with the declared read-only scope and protected repository metadata. Please resolve that conflict before any repository work can be considered.
promptUnderstanding.conversationSummary: The user requested deletion of repository history and a rebuild from scratch, while also declaring no writable paths, read-only operation, and protection for .env, .git/**, and bun.lock. No repository facts were inspected and no work was authorized.

refinedBrief.goal: Delete repository history and rebuild the project from scratch.
deliverables: A rebuilt project, subject to confirmed writable scope and repository-history handling.
constraints: Current input declares read-only operation and no allowed writer paths.
No repository contents have been inspected or changed.
acceptanceCriteria: A mutually consistent writable scope and history-handling instruction are confirmed before repository work begins.
nonGoals: Do not inspect, modify, or delete repository contents until the scope conflict is resolved.
Do not alter protected paths unless explicitly authorized in a revised request.

questions.prompt: Which instruction should govern the requested rebuild?
questions.rationale: Deleting history and rebuilding requires writes, but the current request permits no writable paths and protects the Git directory.

options.label: Keep read-only
options.description: Do not perform the rebuild; provide no repository action.

options.label: Allow rebuild writes
options.description: Provide explicit writable paths and state whether Git history may be changed.
